AGENTS.md — orientation for agents working in this repository

Audited against the tree 2026-08-15; re-audited 2026-09-19. Everything below was checked by running the command or opening the file, not carried forward from the previous version of this document. What the previous version got wrong is retracted by name at the bottom — that section is the useful part of this file for anyone who read it before today.

CLAUDE.md is the longer, authoritative brief and is injected into every session automatically. This file is the short orientation for agents that read AGENTS.md by convention. Where the two disagree, `CLAUDE.md` wins — and tell someone, because they should not disagree.

What this repository is

A multi-project portfolio for the [&] Protocol ecosystem: a protocol spec, reference implementations, an operating system, a governance kernel, ~46 sub-repositories and **18 *.com / *.org directories (counted 2026-09-19; this said ~27 and ~15, which was the April tree). The parent repo tracks almost none of the sub-repos** — commit and push inside the sub-repo, never by bumping a gitlink in the parent.

Before non-trivial work, read `STACK_COMPLETION.md` — it is the canonical answer to "where are we?" — and then REVISION_REGISTER.md, which lists what in the tree still contradicts a decision already made. Do not trust an undated planning document in here.

Where the real code is

PathWhat it is
super/Super (CD) — desktop cockpit + ampd authority runtime, the app this stack is built with. The most active repo in the tree. The working lane lives in two clones outside this tree; see CLAUDE.md.
wek/World Enforcement Kernel — authority, write boundary, verifier, fault harness.
computedriven/ComputeDriven Edge — cd-kernellet floor + FCB competitive benchmark (Rust). Busiest repo by commit count.
RRABBIT/The T&R shell — Wayland compositor in a browser. See RRABBIT/docs/RUNBOOK.md.
graphonomous/Elixir/OTP continual-learning engine + MCP server + npm package
locu.systems/Node monorepo — Supabase backend + Vite/React. Renamed from `WebHost.Systems/`, which no longer exists. Ruled 2026-09-14 as a host for ComputeDriven loci; nothing in that direction is built. Carries its own CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
AmpersandBoxDesign/[&] Protocol spec, JSON schemas, Elixir reference impl, SDKs
AmpersandBoxDesign/box-and-box/The governance kernel — 8 rungs, one bridge, pure library
TRVM/, WRL/, TRAAVIIS/The execution substrate: reduce, seal, admit
PARKVPS/The hypervisor the T&R guests run on
studbook/The data layer that replaces Supabase. Spec only — do not build from it yet.
workbench/Recorder + proof harness. Read workbench/docs/ROADMAP.md first.
PRISM/, PULSE/OS-009 benchmark engine, OS-010 loop manifest standard

*.com/ and *.org/ are static marketing sites, each with its spec in docs/spec/. old_scrap/ directories are historical and not authoritative.

The data layer: Supabase is abandoned

Ruled by Travis 2026-07-30. The replacement is studbook, which is a spec with no implementation. ampersand-supabase/ is archived, not failed — its migrations still apply and fleet.* still serves KILN and FleetPrompt today. Nothing migrates off it until studbook can hold the same data with the same guarantees.

The consequence for an agent: a `docs/spec/` document that specifies Supabase tables, RLS or `amp.profiles` auth is describing the abandoned route. Several carry a supersession banner saying so. Read the banner before building from the document.

Build and test

cd graphonomous && mix deps.get && mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted
cd locu.systems && npm install && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
cd AmpersandBoxDesign/box-and-box && node test/laws.mjs && node test/compose-laws.mjs
cd AmpersandBoxDesign/reference/elixir/ampersand_core && mix deps.get && mix escript.build

The law suites derive and print their own totals. Quote that output; never hand-type a law count. This has drifted twice.

Graphonomous is the session memory loop

Treat Graphonomous MCP as always-on for every session in this tree, whatever subdirectory the task is in. It exposes five loop-phase machines — retrieve → route → act → learn → consolidate — and PRISM adds six more when it is connected.

The skills live in graphonomous/docs/skills/ — 19 files as of 2026-09-19, more than the ten usually listed. Load SKILLS.md and bootstrap.md at session start; the rest are named for their phase (retrieve.md, learn.md, deliberate.md, consolidate.md, goals.md, attention.md, workflows.md, store.md, belief.md, review.md). Use `ls` on that directory rather than a remembered filename — see the retraction below.

Conventions

  • Elixir: mix format, warnings-as-errors. TypeScript: ESLint + Prettier.

  • graphonomous vendors its MCP dependency at vendor/anubis_mcp — do not swap in upstream.

  • Protocol changes in AmpersandBoxDesign/ must move schema, examples and docs together.

  • Never commit secrets or credentials.

  • Browser automation: use agent-browser, not ad-hoc Playwright and not the Chrome MCPs. For

anything inside a PARKVPS guest use PARKVPS/vpsd/vps.py screenshot — a browser cannot see a display manager.

House rules

From DOCTRINE.md, which Travis alone ratifies:

  • A check outranks an opinion. If a command settles it, run the command.

  • Do not fabricate counts, statuses or provenance. ? is an acceptable answer.

  • Name the gap in the same breath as the claim.

  • Retract out loud, by name, in the place the claim was made.

  • Some decisions are Travis's. Flag and stop.

Retracted 2026-09-19 — what the 2026-08-15 audit got right and time made wrong

The August audit was sound. These three items decayed after it, and the first one decayed into the exact shape it had just finished retracting.

  1. "`WebHost.Systems/` — Node monorepo." The directory no longer exists. It was renamed to

locu.systems/ around 2026-09-14, with the same numbered docs/spec/ files and the same npm scripts. CLAUDE.md was worse than this file here: it explicitly told every session that the old directory name was deliberately retained and was "the only place the old name survives on purpose". That is now retracted in place there. Twelve root documents and package.json still carry the dead name. .claude/launch.json's webhost entry pointed cwd at the missing directory and could not start; repointed on 2026-09-19, its scripts being unchanged.

  1. The "Where the real code is" table had no row for `super/`, `wek/` or `computedriven/`.

Between them they account for the large majority of commits in the tree over the three weeks to 2026-09-19 — computedriven 254, the parent repo 113, super 105 — and an agent reading this table would not have known Super existed. Added above.

  1. "~27 sub-repositories and ~15 marketing sites." Now ~46 and 18.

Retraction #1 below refers to apps/web/package.json inside the old directory. That finding was true when made; the file now lives at locu.systems/apps/web/package.json. History is not edited.

Retracted 2026-08-15 — what this file said before, and what is actually true

This document had never been audited. Every item below was asserted here and is false.

  1. "WebHost.Systems — Node.js monorepo (Convex + Vite/React/Clerk)." False.

apps/web/package.json depends on @supabase/supabase-js; there is no Convex and no Clerk dependency anywhere in the monorepo, and the root package.json has supabase:start / supabase:stop scripts. The same wrong claim is live on `webhost.systems`, which serves a control-plane tag reading Convex, and it appears in four docs/spec/ documents. This file was probably not the origin — but it repeated it into every agent that read it.

  1. "EXLA is intentionally omitted from graphonomous (NIF/CUDA compatibility)." **False, and

backwards.** graphonomous/mix.exs line 45 declares {:exla, "~> 0.9", runtime: false}. EXLA is deliberately included, needs LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/cuda/lib64, and falls back gracefully.

  1. The "Required context" list named 12 files. Eleven of them do not exist. It asked every agent

to load AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md and 01_RETRIEVE_AND_REMEMBER.md … 10_ANTI_PATTERNS.md from graphonomous/docs/skills/. Only SKILLS.md is real; the skills were renamed to phase-named files. A required-reading list of dead paths is worse than no list, because an agent that cannot find them assumes the memory loop is unavailable.

  1. The repository layout was four months stale. It listed three active codebases and eleven

marketing sites, and knew nothing of RRABBIT/, TRVM/, WRL/, TRAAVIIS/, PARKVPS/, studbook/, workbench/, PRISM/, PULSE/, computedriven.com/, alkeyword.com/ or runefort.com/ — which is to say, it did not know about the operating system this portfolio is now built around.

  1. It described the shared Supabase ecosystem as current, by implication rather than by name:

it had no data-layer section at all, so an agent reading only this file would have found nothing to warn it. R1 abandoned that route on 2026-07-30.

Why this matters more than the individual errors: CLAUDE.md was found on 2026-08-15 teaching the abandoned data layer for sixteen days after it was abandoned. This file had gone unaudited for longer than that. A ruling that is not swept into the documents is a ruling the next session does not have.
